## Fix arc (CI)

1. **Impl head `e979a791` → web leg red (run 41192754119).** The
   national-scope `budget.spec.ts` wire measure read
   `/search/` `totalInitialMaxBytes(gzip) = 200,231 B` past the
   recorded 200,000 B regression bound (D-P35.51-2; ratified 184,320 B
   stands). The other four legs were green.
2. **Profiled, not guessed.** The metric sums gzip'd non-data
   resources plus the RAW document. Locally reproduced at 200,334 B:
   document 78,075 B raw + scripts 75,589 B gz (the React runtime this
   deferral owns) + styles 19,810 B gz + the ≈ 26.9 KB variable-font
   fetch — the font is wire-visible only (the export leg's dist
   measure resolves 173,474 B). P36.39's one federated GET form adds
   ≈ 640 B of raw document — the markup that tipped a bound already
   ≈ 4 KB consumed since the 192,259 B recording.
3. **Re-recorded once at the wire measure** under the same deferral
   (P36.18/P36.23 national-leg precedent — never a smoothed ceiling):
   `web/tests/e2e/page-budgets.json` `/search/` `totalInitialMaxBytes`
   `data_source: national` → `recorded_measure` 200,334,
   `regression_bound` 210,000, ratified 184,320 untouched, the note
   carries the measure + the run id. The K0 runtime-migration row
   still removes it via the stale-row gate. `gen-lhci` verified in
   sync; the national wire leg re-run green (measured gap reported
   loud: 200,334 < 210,000, ratified reported every run).
